name: Lyrebird
about: Talk and listen: type, hold the microphone to talk, or the phone for a hands-free call. Answers are spoken sentence by sentence while they are written; each keeps its recording to play again. How it speaks and listens is set on the right.

chat.placeholder: Type, hold the microphone to talk, or the phone for a hands-free call (Ctrl+Enter sends)

inputs.system: You are speaking aloud with the person. Answer in short spoken sentences: no lists, tables or code unless asked.
